app_store.name: BastionPDF: Document Security
app_store.subtitle: Private In-Browser PDF Tools
app_store.promotional_text: Transform confidential documents directly on your device. Zero cloud uploads, zero tracking cookies, zero ads. Merge, split, and protect PDFs with native security.
app_store.description:
BastionPDF is a privacy-first document workstation built for professionals who handle sensitive and confidential records.

Unlike traditional cloud converters that transmit your contracts, tax returns, and medical files across third-party remote servers, BastionPDF executes document transformations directly on your device using WebAssembly and client-side processing. Zero bytes leave your hardware.

KEY CAPABILITIES:
- Merge & Organize: Combine dozens of PDF documents and reorder pages effortlessly.
- Split & Extract: Extract custom page ranges or split large documents into individual files.
- Page Numbering: Apply standardized bates stamps and custom page headers/footers.
- Watermarking: Protect confidential drafts with customizable text and image watermarks.
- Instant Hard Purge: Revoke and overwrite memory buffers in a single tap for guaranteed zero-trace security.

BUILT FOR PRIVACY:
- Zero server uploads for standard operations
- Zero tracking cookies, zero advertising networks
- Works offline without an active internet connection
- Ideal for HIPAA, GDPR, and confidential corporate compliance

Take complete ownership of your document privacy with BastionPDF.
app_store.whats_new: Initial release of BastionPDF sovereign document workstation. Includes zero-upload client-side PDF merging, splitting, watermarking, page numbering, and instant zero-trace memory purging.
